cohort: The study participants consisted of 1027 women (341 cases with PLTCs and 686 controls without PLTCs) from Tigray, northern Ethiopia.
finding: Several sociodemographic, obstetric, and health-related factors, including lack of education, alcohol intake, twin birth, chronic hypertension, and prior/current cesarean section or induced labor, were identified as determinants increasing the risk of PLTCs, while completing prenatal care visits was protective.
mod_finding: Prior cesarean section, induced labor, and current cesarean section delivery were all found to significantly increase the risk of potentially life-threatening maternal conditions.
